title: Release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad
content:
Release day scratchpad / cutover checklist - personal notes
Date: 2025-11-02 (cutover day)
Owner: Jordan Lee (release eng)
Slack channel: #release-cutover (pin: https://slack/redwood/rel-cutover)
Primary runbook (confluence): Release Playbook (linked above)
On-call SRE: Maya Chen, Backup: Ravi Kumar

SUMMARY / GOAL:
- Push platform v2.14.0 to production with hotfix backports (see backport list).
- Maintain <200ms p50 API latency for critical routes during cutover.
- No-data-loss; all DB migrations are no-op or pre-applied.

QUICK STATUS (morning):
- Smoke deploy to staging: OK (2025-11-01 22:30 UTC)
- Canary on dedicated pool: 10% traffic, pass basic smoke, no regressions
- Open bugs blocking release: REL-2025-3 (minor auth header edge) -> RAV (low)

PRE-CUTOVER CHECKS (1-2 hours before):
- [ ] Confirm all release PRs merged and tags created (git tag v2.14.0).
  - PR list: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls?q=is%3Apr+milestone%3Av2.14.0
- [ ] Verify schema migrations are already applied to prod-test and staging.
- [ ] Database backups: manual snapshot taken at 2025-11-02T04:15Z (backup-id: snap-rl-20251102).
- [ ] Alerting: temporary threshold relaxation patch merged (cpu/latency thresholds increased for 30m).
- [ ] Notify customer-success and oncall via #release-notify: small email to enterprise customers scheduled.

GO / NO-GO (15 minutes before):
- [ ] Health checks green for 30m on canary (ops-dashboard).
- [ ] No P0/P1 incidents in last 1h.
- [ ] Approval from Eng PM (Olivia) and SRE lead (Maya).
- My call: GO (unless metrics spike or blocking bug pops).

CUTOVER STEPS (ordered):
1) Start rollout (t=0)
   - Command: deployctl promote --env=prod --tag=v2.14.0 --strategy=rolling --batch=10%
   - Owner: Jordan (kickoff) / Ravi (monitor)
2) Verify canary (t=+5m)
   - Check canary traces and error budget dashboard (trace-samples, error-rate).
   - Query: dashboards -> Prod / v2.14.0 / p50/p95.
   - If error-rate > 0.5% for 5m -> PAUSE and rollback canary.
3) Expand rollout to 33% (t=+15m)
4) Full rollout if metrics stable (t=+45m)

IMMEDIATE POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATIONS (first 60m):
- [ ] API health: /health endpoint, 200 for all replicas.
- [ ] Latency: p50/p95 for routes /generate and /embed within SLO.
- [ ] Error budget: error-rate < 0.2% sustained.
- [ ] Logs: no surge in 5xx for auth or KV cache code paths.
- [ ] Traces: no unusually long KV cache misses.
- [ ] Manual sanity: hit a few user flows (signup, login, sample-generation).

BACKPORTS / HOTFIXES (short list)
- REL-2025-7: backport quantization bug fix to v2.13.x (branch: hotfix/qfix-quant).
  - Owner: Ravi Kumar.
  - Status: backported + staged. Need smoke confirm post-deploy.
- REL-2025-9: backport auth header fix to v2.13.x (branch: hotfix/auth-compat).
  - Owner: Jordan.
  - Status: pending review (PR #4123).
Notes: if hotfix PR not merged by t=-30m, delay cutover by 60m or run rollback path available.

ROLLBACK PLAN (fast):
- Trigger: sustained error rate > 1% for 10m or major customer impact.
- Steps:
  - deployctl promote --env=prod --tag=v2.13.5 --strategy=immediate
  - Notify #release-cutover and #sre-oncall, set paging to high.
  - If db migration was destructive (shouldn't be): consult DB runbook (Confluence link).

COMMUNICATIONS / NOTES TO SEND
- Pre-cutover (T-60m): post status in #release-notify: starting cutover in 60m, expected 45-90m, minor risk for short latency blips.
- On success: short post in #release-notify and email to cs-team with link to changelog.
- On rollback: immediate alert + follow-up summary with root cause once triaged.

COMMANDS / QUICK REFERENCE
- Promote rollout: deployctl promote --env=prod --tag=v2.14.0
- Rollback: deployctl promote --env=prod --tag=v2.13.5 --strategy=immediate
- Check logs: splunk query: index=prod service=platform "v2.14.0"
- Run smoke test suite: ./scripts/run_smoke.sh --env=prod --tag=v2.14.0

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO (personal scratchpad)
- [ ] Confirm whether we should enable new batching config for embeddings in this release or defer. (Might increase p95)
- [ ] Follow up with Product on customer-facing changelog wording for caching changes.
- [ ] Ask infra if they expect any autoscaler flaps during pod churn.

POST-MORTEM NOTES (template)
- If anything goes wrong: capture timeline (UTC), affected endpoints, rollback decision time, root cause candidate, mitigation steps, and action items with owners. Use template: Confluence -> Release Postmortem.

PERSONAL REMINDERS (notes to self):
- Keep a running 1-line timestamped log in this file during cutover (example: [05:12Z] canary healthy).
- If I step away for >10m, handover to Ravi and leave a short note in Slack.

EXAMPLE TIMELINE LOG (for copy/paste)
[04:50Z] pre-cutover checks completed
[05:02Z] started canary (10%)
[05:08Z] canary healthy, expand to 33%
[05:30Z] full rollout initiated
[05:40Z] p95 spike to 420ms -> reverted batch config on subset -> recovering

END OF SCRATCHPAD
(Will move a cleaned-up checklist to Confluence if this becomes the canonical runbook.)
